description: Voltage-controlled filter on a V2164 core, with simultaneous two-pole low-pass and band-pass outputs; at high resonance it self-oscillates as a clean sine oscillator

params.text: Sets the cutoff frequency; fully clockwise the filter is wide open, and fully counter-clockwise it is shut and nothing passes
Sets the resonance, emphasising the frequencies around the cutoff; self-oscillation begins at about 80 percent of the travel
Attenuates and inverts the voltage at the CVF input before it reaches the cutoff frequency
Attenuates and inverts the voltage at the CVR input before it reaches the resonance

inputs.text: Modulates the cutoff frequency, through the CVF knob
Sets the cutoff frequency one octave per volt with no attenuation, so the filter tracks a keyboard
Modulates the resonance, through the CVR knob; about 4V here brings the filter to self-oscillation
The signal into the filter, DC-coupled

outputs.text: The two-pole low-pass output, falling 12dB per octave above the cutoff
The two-pole band-pass output, 12dB per octave either side of the cutoff

notes: nothing reaches the outputs with the cutoff knob fully counter-clockwise, where the filter is shut.

inputs.1: 1V per octave · continuous · one channel only
